newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Aust Infrastructure list at premium.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Aust Infrastructure list at premium.

text.p: The securities of infrastructure investor Australian Infrastructure Group made their debut on the Australian Stock Exchange on Thursday at A$2.32, a 32 cent premium to their issue price of A$2.00.
Each security comprises one unit in the trust paid to A$1.70 stapled to one share in the company fully paid to A$0.30.
The group's focus is on infrastructure that investors find difficult to invest in, particularly unlisted investments.
By 11.20 a.m. (0020 GMT), Australian Infrastructure securities were at A$2.27 with 3.4 million securities traded.
